theorems.name: Submission.dor_imrep_massOn_eq_measure_and_support
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) ∧ T.support = U ∩ R.measure.support
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
